fixed_paragraph: When someone asks for my help, I often decline if it doesn't benefit me. When a friend shares their opinion, I challenge it if I disagree. When a colleague suggests a plan, I point out the flaws without sugarcoating. When someone tries to persuade me, I hold my ground firmly. When a group decision is made, I voice my dissent if I don't agree. When someone makes a mistake, I don't hesitate to call it out. When a stranger asks for a favor, I usually refuse unless there's something in it for me. When a conversation gets heated, I don't back down easily. When someone criticizes me, I respond with equal intensity. When a rule seems pointless, I question it openly.
